quests.question: People widely believe that the new prime minister will raise taxes within the year.
quests.sentence: People widely believe that the new prime minister will raise taxes within the year.
quests.hint: 'People widely believe' - impersonal active; 'people' performs the believing action on the that-clause.
quests.explanation: Simple present active (impersonal). 'People' (doer) + 'widely believe' (verb + adverb) + 'that the prime minister will raise taxes' (that-clause object). Impersonal active using 'people' as generic subject.

quests.question: Everyone expects the company's share price to recover strongly in the next quarter.
quests.sentence: Everyone expects the company's share price to recover strongly in the next quarter.
quests.hint: Who expects the recovery? Everyone - present active with 'expect + object + infinitive'.
quests.explanation: Simple present active. 'Everyone' (doer) + 'expects' (verb) + 'the share price' (object) + 'to recover strongly' (infinitive complement). Generic subject with object + infinitive structure.

quests.question: Analysts report that unemployment has fallen to its lowest level in over fifteen years.
quests.sentence: Analysts report that unemployment has fallen to its lowest level in over fifteen years.
quests.hint: Who reports this? Analysts - present active; professionals communicate a finding.
quests.explanation: Simple present active. 'Analysts' (doer) + 'report' (verb) + 'that unemployment has fallen…' (that-clause object). Professional reporting in the active voice.

quests.question: It is widely believed that the new prime minister will raise taxes within the year.
quests.sentence: It is widely believed that the new prime minister will raise taxes within the year.
quests.hint: 'It is believed that…' = impersonal it-passive. The belief is passively expressed without naming believers.
quests.explanation: Impersonal it-passive. 'It' (placeholder) + 'is believed' (is + past participle) + 'that the prime minister will raise taxes'. Impersonal passive used to report widespread belief without specifying who believes it.

quests.question: The company's share price is expected to recover strongly in the next quarter.
quests.sentence: The company's share price is expected to recover strongly in the next quarter.
quests.hint: 'Is expected to recover' = passive with infinitive complement. Share price receives the expectation.
quests.explanation: Passive with infinitive complement. 'The share price' (receiver) + 'is expected' (is + past participle) + 'to recover strongly'. The infinitive is the content of the expectation. Impersonal - no specific agent.

quests.question: Unemployment is reported to have fallen to its lowest level in over fifteen years.
quests.sentence: Unemployment is reported to have fallen to its lowest level in over fifteen years.
quests.hint: 'Is reported to have fallen' = passive with perfect infinitive. The result is passively attributed.
quests.explanation: Passive with perfect infinitive. 'Unemployment' (receiver) + 'is reported' (is + past participle) + 'to have fallen…' (perfect infinitive). Perfect infinitive shows the reported event preceded the reporting.

quests.question: Historians widely regard Shakespeare as the greatest playwright in the English language.
quests.sentence: Historians widely regard Shakespeare as the greatest playwright in the English language.
quests.hint: Who regards Shakespeare this way? Historians - present active; professional scholarly opinion.
quests.explanation: Simple present active. 'Historians' (doer) + 'widely regard' (verb + adverb) + 'Shakespeare' (object) + 'as the greatest playwright' (complement). Active scholarly appraisal.

quests.question: Archaeologists believe the site dates back at least three thousand years.
quests.sentence: Archaeologists believe the site dates back at least three thousand years.
quests.hint: Who believes this? Archaeologists - present active; professional expert opinion.
quests.explanation: Simple present active. 'Archaeologists' (doer) + 'believe' (verb) + 'the site dates back 3000 years' (object clause). Expert professional opinion in active voice.

quests.question: People once thought the earth was flat and that the sun revolved around it.

quests.question: Shakespeare is widely regarded by historians as the greatest playwright in the English language.

quests.question: The site is believed by archaeologists to date back at least three thousand years.
quests.sentence: The site is believed by archaeologists to date back at least three thousand years.

quests.explanation: Passive with agent + infinitive. 'The site' (receiver) + 'is believed' (is + past participle) + 'by archaeologists' (agent) + 'to date back 3000 years' (infinitive). Expert belief in passive.

quests.question: The earth was once thought to be flat and to revolve around the sun.
quests.sentence: The earth was once thought to be flat and to revolve around the sun.
quests.hint: 'Was thought to be flat' = past passive with two parallel infinitive complements. Historical impersonal belief.
quests.explanation: Past passive with parallel infinitives. 'The earth' (receiver) + 'was thought' (was + past participle) + 'to be flat' + 'and to revolve around the sun' (parallel infinitives). Historical impersonal passive.

quests.question: The jury found the defendant guilty of all three serious charges against him.

quests.question: He is believed by legal experts to have committed the offences over a prolonged period.

quests.explanation: Passive with agent + perfect infinitive. 'He' (receiver) + 'is believed' (is + past participle) + 'by legal experts' (agent) + 'to have committed…' (perfect infinitive = action before the current belief).

quests.question: The original conviction is widely expected to be overturned by the appeal court.

quests.question: The social media company is known to have repeatedly violated data protection regulations.
